claims.evidence: Only exterior of mounted lens shown; no close-up of glass element or interior.

risks.risk: Camera body model may not be the G7 as claimed, affecting value tier
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model badge/engraving on the top plate or bottom serial plate
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic/unspecified Lumix mirrorless body, lowest plausible model tier

risks.risk: Only one battery may actually be included, not two
risks.proof: Photo showing both batteries side by side together with the charger

risks.risk: Shutter count could be much higher than claimed, affecting mechanical wear value
risks.proof: Photo/screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data of a test shot
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavy-use/high shutter count unit

risks.risk: Lens could have internal fungus, haze, or scratches not visible externally
risks.proof: Macro photo/video of lens held up to light showing front and rear elements
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with possible fungus/haze, worst case

risks.risk: Screen may have faults beyond the clock-reset prompt (e.g., dead pixels, hinge issues)
risks.proof: Video of screen cycling through menus and live view feed
risks.if_unproven: priced as screen with unknown/possible defects

risks.risk: No memory card, bag, or box included, which could affect bundle value
risks.proof: Photo of full bundle contents laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens+battery+charger only, no accessories

risks.risk: Unverified repair/service history could mean hidden part replacements
risks.proof: Photo of any service sticker, invoice, or seal condition on body screws

proof_requests: Close-up of model name/number engraving on top plate or bottom serial plate
Photo showing both batteries together with charger
Shutter count screenshot from camera menu
Macro photo of lens front and rear elements under light
Video of LCD screen cycling through menus and live preview
Photo of complete accessory bundle (card, bag, box if any)
Any photo of original purchase receipt or service record
response.reason: The witness confirms a Lumix mirrorless camera with lens, one battery, and charger, so it can be priced at worst case; model identity, battery count, shutter count, and lens condition remain unverified or contradicted pending further proof.
